svg.text: Absolute difference between model and measurement where a model value was computed; bounds are shown as a margin, not as a deviation
NO ROW HAS A POINT COMPARISON AVAILABLE
Model value over upper bound (inequality, not a deviation)
bound reached (ratio 1): above this line the model exceeds the bound
Hollow ring: Cs-134, DATA INCOMPLETE (denominator not established): value shown for scale, no status of comparison
Hollow square: Ag-110m, DATA INCOMPLETE, shown for scale
Filled triangle pointing down: upper bound satisfied by the model
Hollow vermilion triangle pointing down: upper bound exceeded by the model

Relative deviation is undefined for a measured value that is not positive and no near-zero floor is applied, because no row states a detection floor (decision 17); no accuracy threshold is used. Provisional values
never enter an aggregate or a status. Upper bounds are inequalities and never enter a deviation. Model: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference, package version 1.0.1, commit

ef34d34169360c8790a559e40c5952aa65561c73; registered AGR1-B-M16 geometry; published heating-test diffusion coefficients of register set C16-T2 with buffer C16-BUF, evaluated at the test temperature; kernel-only
start; constant temperature; decay and generation are not in the solver. This is a numerical comparison, not an experimental validation.
